column4: setupCDDrive: the Complete entry at 0x50c1c0 is patched to mov eax,7 / ret (6 bytes, src/misc.cpp). The cut prologue 55 8b ec 81 ec [00 02 00 00] leaves 02 00 00 at 0x50c1c6; decoding resumes at 0x50c1c9 (push ebx/esi/edi) and runs to the original ret at 0x50c598 without a gap, followed by seven NOPs of the original COMDAT fill up to fileSize at 0x50c5a0. Its operands (drive/MCI strings, GetDriveTypeA, mciSendCommandA) are admitted relocation sites; nothing in the image references an address inside it.
